evidence: Original configurable starting exercises, informed by primary sources and The Red session readbacks. Not transcriptions of reference artists' sessions.

rock_dubstep.title: Recognizable rock riff into a half-time drop
rock_dubstep.intent: Keep the hook and singing; rebuild drums and low end, with source audio plus selected riff MIDI.

smooth_wobble.title: Held sub and rounded wobble
smooth_wobble.intent: Sparse motion around the original phrase, with continuous singing and a stable mono root.

riddim.title: Sparse repeating bass motif with answers
riddim.intent: An original riddim-inspired exercise with syncopation and selected triplet offsets; not a definition that all riddim must use triplets.

sources.title: Ableton / Side Brain: A Step-by-Step Guide to Remixing a Track
sources.supports: Stem selection, audio-to-MIDI cleanup, sample chopping and rebuilding a rhythm foundation.
sources.limits: Read article and tutorial outline; embedded video not auditioned. Demonstration uses Live 12.3 Suite, not proof of capability in Live 12.2.5.

sources.title: Native Instruments / Tim Cant: How to make a dubstep track that hits hard on the dance floor
sources.supports: 140 BPM example, beat-three snares, varying drum velocities and swung subdivisions.
sources.limits: Search-indexed article text checked; direct page redirected during research. The recipe's exact patterns are original.

sources.title: W. A. Production / Dan Larsson: Riddim Bass
sources.supports: Tutorial descriptions cover a simple single-LFO bass, automated reverb, flange and all-pass filtering as different sound-design options.
sources.limits: Course page and indexed descriptions only; lessons not watched. No claim about an exact artist patch.

sources.title: ICON Collective / Kompany: Bass Resampling with Serum in Ableton Live
sources.supports: Producer demonstration of a synth-to-audio resampling workflow.
sources.limits: Indexed tutorial description checked; direct page failed to fetch and video was not auditioned.

sources.title: Ableton Live 12 Manual: Audio Clips, Tempo, and Warping
sources.supports: Distinguishing independent timing/pitch changes from playback-rate changes; preserving source Warp alignment.
sources.limits: Read documentation, not proof of connector support for every control.

sources.title: Ableton / Dennis DeSantis: Making Music, Choosing a Tempo
sources.supports: Creative coexistence of half-time and double-time feels on a fast grid.
sources.limits: Indexed passage checked; not a notation change or automatic tempo recommendation.
